newsitem.title: USA: Zenith to unveil digital video disc player.
newsitem.headline: Zenith to unveil digital video disc player.

text.p: Zenith Electronics Corp said it will introduce on Thursday the DVD2000 digital video disc player at the Winter Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas.
The digital television product will work with existing analog discs and yet-to-be-released digital discs.

The new DVD technology allows a high transfer rate up to 10 megabits per second and 4.7 gigabyte capacity, providing up to 133 minutes of full-resolution video and CD-quality sound -- all on a 5-inch disc.
Zenith Sales Co president Bill Sims, in a statement, described DVD as a highly flexible technology platform.
"It can accommodate new functions and capabilities that haven't been developed yet," Sims noted.
Zenith spokesman John Taylor said the new device, which will ship to retailers in the spring, will work on any television on the market.
"It's a new product category. The applications for multimedia are endless," Taylor said.
